classAbilities.name: Cleric — Turn Undead
classAbilities.notes: Can turn or destroy undead creatures

classAbilities.name: Fighter — Weapon Specialization
classAbilities.notes: May specialize in weapons (if using optional rule)

classAbilities.name: Fighter — Followers
classAbilities.notes: Attracts 10-100 followers and may build a stronghold; they arrive once and are never replaced

racialAbilities.name: Constitution Save Bonuses
racialAbilities.notes: +1 per 3 1/2 points of Constitution against wands, staves, rods and spells, and the same bonus against poison (PHB Table 9). Already applied to your saving throws

racialAbilities.name: Detect Stonework
racialAbilities.notes: Within 10 feet, and only when deliberately trying: grade or slope in passage 1-5 on 1d6; new tunnel or passage construction 1-5 on 1d6; sliding or shifting walls or rooms 1-4 on 1d6; stonework traps, pits and deadfalls 1-3 on 1d6

racialAbilities.name: Determine Depth
racialAbilities.notes: Approximate depth below the surface, 1-3 on 1d6. May be attempted at any time, not only within 10 feet

racialAbilities.name: Attack Bonus vs. Orcs/Goblins
racialAbilities.notes: +1 to hit orcs, half-orcs, goblins, hobgoblins

racialAbilities.name: AC Bonus vs. Giants
racialAbilities.notes: Giants, ogres, trolls, ogre magi and titans get -4 to hit you. An attack penalty on them, not a bonus to your AC -- it does not apply against anything else

racialAbilities.name: Nonmagical Nature
racialAbilities.notes: Dwarves never use magical (wizard) spells. Priest spells are allowed

racialAbilities.name: Magic Item Malfunction
racialAbilities.notes: 20% chance of malfunction each time you use a magical item not suited to your class -- rods, staves, wands, rings, amulets, potions, horns, jewels and the like. Weapons, shields, armor, gauntlets and girdles are exempt, as are priest items used by a dwarven cleric. A device that operates CONTINUALLY is checked only the first time it is used in an encounter; pass, and it works until it is turned off -- a robe of blending is checked when donned and not again until it is removed and put back on. Affects only that use; a cursed item that malfunctions reveals itself

armor.name: Gauntlets, Metal
armor.notes: Metal gauntlets, full hand protection. Improves unarmed damage.

armor.name: Helmet, Metal Helm
armor.notes: Standard metal helmet, protects against critical hits (optional rule)

nwps.name: Armorer
nwps.notes: Make and repair metal armor and shields. Requires forge.

nwps.name: Blacksmithing
nwps.notes: Create and repair metal objects. Requires forge and tools.

nwps.name: Ancient History
nwps.notes: Knowledge of historical events, personalities, wars, migrations, etc.

nwps.name: Carpentry
nwps.notes: Build wooden structures and items. Requires tools.

nwps.name: Direction Sense
nwps.notes: Instinctively know direction of north. Less chance of getting lost.

nwps.name: Engineering
nwps.notes: Design and build large structures, siege engines, and fortifications
